method: Fresh supplied float32 WAV identity check against previously decoded actual mockup PCM. WAV averaged to mono and 11025 Hz using a 4-sample box filter. Normalized waveform correlation with 11025 Hz refinement. Correlation scores are not probabilities. Positive high scores across broadband duration support identity; weak scores do not establish absence.
